title: S2 order-book-builder — API surface
description: Port 7620, prefix OBB-. Endpoints (from router.py): GET /healthz, /readyz, /books, /book/{symbol}, /tob/{symbol}, /events, /stats; POST /rebuild/{symbol} (no body). /book/{symbol} returns a book snapshot (schemas/wire/book-snapshot-wire.schema.json); /tob/{symbol} returns the top-of-block object from that schema. GET /events streams chunked JSON-lines BookEvent objects.

bookResponse.description: GET /book/{symbol} — one book snapshot (per venue, or a venue-keyed map when the symbol is listed at multiple venues).

topOfBookResponse.description: GET /tob/{symbol} — the top-of-block view for the book.

bookEvent.description: One element of the GET /events response (also the shape streamed to subscribers): a material change event. Keys use descriptive names (symbol/venue), not wire shorthand.
